svg.title: Your AI on its own versus with Juggle: Answers your whole request, not just the last message: Left to chance on its own, Rebuilds the brief with Juggle; Corrections replace the old value everywhere: Left to chance on its own, Newest wins with Juggle; 'Do this first' without dropping the rest: Left to chance on its own, Reorders, drops nothing with Juggle; Stops when you say stop: Usually on its own, Cancels that item with Juggle; Spots a new message breaking your own rule: Left to chance on its own, Safe default, you override with Juggle; Reads fast phone typing without fuss: Usually on its own, Reads for intent with Juggle; Tells you what is done, next and waiting on you: If you ask on its own, Every multi-ask reply with Juggle; Never claims it checked what it cannot check: Left to chance on its own, Says how to check with Juggle.
